title: The Pale Echo
author: Odile Delacroix
blurb: August Coldharbour, an insurance investigator of impossible accidents, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. But when the colony's children start sharing the same dream, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
